card.name: Linking words before fungal or microbe names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'as' or 'an' right before an infection-causing organism or antifungal drug name, mostly in antifungal labels. Also partway through names like micafungin and isavuconazole.

modes.label: 'of' before fungus names
modes.description: The word 'of' after prophylaxis or development, just before Aspergillus, Candida or resistant bacteria.
modes.example: of age and older who weigh greater than 40 kg for the treatment of invasive aspergillosis and prophylaxis<< of>> invasive Aspergillus and Candida

modes.label: Inside antifungal names
modes.description: Partway through antifungal drug or fungus names such as micafungin, isavuconazole or Scedosporium.
